import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem power_difference_residue_bounded (t r : ℕ) (A B : ℤ) (hr : r ≤ 5) (hA : A ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7]) (hB : B ≡ 5 [ZMOD 7]) : A ^ (6 * t + r) - B ^ (6 * t + r) ≡ (match r with | 0 => 0 | 1 => 3 | 2 => 4 | 3 => 2 | 4 => 6 | 5 => 5 | _ => 0) [ZMOD 7] := by
  have hA6 : A ^ 6 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      A ^ 6 ≡ 1 ^ 6 [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow 6 hA
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
  have hB6 : B ^ 6 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      B ^ 6 ≡ 5 ^ 6 [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow 6 hB
      _ ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by native_decide
  have hA6t : A ^ (6 * t) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      A ^ (6 * t) = (A ^ 6) ^ t := by rw [← pow_mul]
      _ ≡ 1 ^ t [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow t hA6
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hB6t : B ^ (6 * t) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      B ^ (6 * t) = (B ^ 6) ^ t := by rw [← pow_mul]
      _ ≡ 1 ^ t [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow t hB6
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hA_total : A ^ (6 * t + r) ≡ A ^ r [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      A ^ (6 * t + r) = A ^ (6 * t) * A ^ r := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≡ 1 * A ^ r [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.mul hA6t (Int.ModEq.refl _)
      _ = A ^ r := by simp
  have hB_total : B ^ (6 * t + r) ≡ B ^ r [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      B ^ (6 * t + r) = B ^ (6 * t) * B ^ r := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≡ 1 * B ^ r [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.mul hB6t (Int.ModEq.refl _)
      _ = B ^ r := by simp
  have h_diff : A ^ (6 * t + r) - B ^ (6 * t + r) ≡ A ^ r - B ^ r [ZMOD 7] :=
    Int.ModEq.sub hA_total hB_total
  have hA_r : A ^ r ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    calc
      A ^ r ≡ 1 ^ r [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow r hA
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have hB_r : B ^ r ≡ 5 ^ r [ZMOD 7] := Int.ModEq.pow r hB
  have h_diff2 : A ^ r - B ^ r ≡ 1 - 5 ^ r [ZMOD 7] :=
    Int.ModEq.sub hA_r hB_r
  have h_final : A ^ (6 * t + r) - B ^ (6 * t + r) ≡ 1 - 5 ^ r [ZMOD 7] :=
    h_diff.trans h_diff2

  · simpa using h_final
  · simpa using h_final
  · simpa using h_final
  · simpa using h_final
